composite_ranking.reason: DVR Signal currently publishes source-backed factual indicators rather than an evaluative composite score.

participant_mode.note: Participant mode remains disabled until a disclosure-reviewed aggregate release exists.

issues.title: Resource capacity / Order of Selection
issues.definition: Program capacity and the current use of Order of Selection when DVR reports insufficient resources to serve all eligible participants.

trend_series.label: Priority categories closed at end of available half-year snapshots
trend_series.note: The historical points are retrospective reconstructions from the Dec. 2025 closure and later official sources; they are not archived webpage captures.

unknowns: The current source set does not provide a current public count of people on the waitlist.
planned_improvements: DVR states that participants may be released from the waitlist as resources become available.

issues.title: Counselor workload
issues.definition: Caseload size and staffing capacity affecting case-carrying vocational rehabilitation counselors.

current_indicator.label: VRC4 staff with caseloads above 100
current_indicator.display_value: 64% in current final plan; 40% in 2026 draft

supporting_indicators.label: Current final State Plan statement
supporting_indicators.display_value: 64% of VRC4 staff manage caseloads above 100

supporting_indicators.label: 2026 draft State Plan update
supporting_indicators.display_value: 40% of VRC4 staff manage caseloads above 100

trend_series.label: VRC4 caseloads above 100
trend_series.note: Comparable trend unavailable because the current final plan and its 2026 draft contain materially different percentages without a reconciled reporting-period explanation.

source_conflicts: The current final 2026-2028 State Plan text reports 64%; the 2026 draft update reports 40%. DVR Signal does not select one as the trend value without a reconciled source explanation.
unknowns: The final plan text does not identify the measurement date for the 64% figure.
A current statewide median, P75, and P90 counselor caseload distribution is not in the source set.
planned_improvements: DVR reports additional counselor hiring and use of Order of Selection to reduce caseload pressure.

issues.title: Staff turnover and continuity
issues.definition: Continuity of counselor assignment, including the number of counselors participants report having during their DVR experience.

trend_series.label: Counselor-count continuity
trend_series.note: Comparable trend unavailable because the CSNA provides one cross-sectional distribution rather than repeated comparable periods.

source_conflicts: The CSNA narrative summary says 22% had three or more counselors, while Table 10 separately reports 15.8% with three, 5.7% with four, and 6.6% with more than four. DVR Signal preserves the table categories rather than silently reconciling the discrepancy.
unknowns: Counselor count does not establish why a reassignment occurred and is not an administrative turnover rate.
A current statewide vacancy duration and reassignment-duration dataset is not in the public source set.
planned_improvements: The CSNA recommends staffing, backfill, triage, and continuity strategies.
DVR reports using float VRCs for cases that cannot immediately transfer to a local counselor.

issues.title: Funding and resource pressure
issues.definition: Available program resources, reimbursement, service costs, and caseload demand affecting DVR operating capacity.

current_indicator.label: Case-service expenditures
current_indicator.display_value: $27.4M in PY2024, up nearly 57% from $17.5M in PY2021

supporting_indicators.label: SSA reimbursement change reported by DVR
Federal program context
supporting_indicators.display_value: State VR Services is a federal formula-grant program administered by RSA

trend_series.label: Case-service expenditures
trend_series.note: This series measures expenditures, not federal grant cuts. The State Plan attributes the broader resource constraint to multiple factors.

unknowns: Expenditure growth does not by itself establish that federal appropriations fell.
A complete inflation-adjusted resource-per-active-case series has not yet been assembled.
planned_improvements: DVR reports cost-containment measures, fiscal monitoring, and use of Order of Selection.

issues.title: Communication reliability and service timeliness
issues.definition: Participant contact standards, counselor accessibility, transfer communication, and a related customer measure of service timeliness.

current_indicator.label: Contact standards reported by DVR
current_indicator.display_value: 48-hour response standard; interactions documented within 10 days

supporting_indicators.label: Ease reaching counselor, CSNA
supporting_indicators.display_value: 29.5% very easy; 40.2% somewhat easy; 16.4% somewhat difficult; 13.9% very difficult (n=664)

supporting_indicators.label: Departure continuity measure
supporting_indicators.display_value: 30-day automatic email reply after counselor departure

trend_series.label: Statewide share agreeing that DVR moves quickly enough
trend_series.note: This is a related service-timeliness satisfaction series, not a measured 48-hour response-compliance rate. The source text contains an apparent calendar-year labeling inconsistency for FFY25 Q1, so DVR Signal displays the fiscal-quarter labels only.

unknowns: No public statewide compliance percentage for the 48-hour response standard is in the source set.
The CSNA reachability measure is cross-sectional and is not the same measure as the response standard.
planned_improvements: DVR reports float VRC coverage, automatic replies after departure, and a standardized communication protocol.

issues.title: Qualified-staff pipeline
issues.definition: Recruitment, training, vacancy coverage, and the time required for new vocational rehabilitation counselors to carry a full caseload.

current_indicator.label: VR counselors hired
current_indicator.display_value: 37 hired in the prior year, according to the current final plan
current_indicator.measurement_period: Prior year as described in the 2026-2028 State Plan

supporting_indicators.label: 2026 draft staffing action
supporting_indicators.display_value: 25 new VR counselor positions added; many reported filled

supporting_indicators.label: 2026 draft qualified counselor ratio
supporting_indicators.display_value: 150 qualified case-carrying counselors / 10,300 customers = stated 69:1 as of Dec. 31, 2025

supporting_indicators.label: Experienced-position pipeline
supporting_indicators.display_value: Open VRC3/VRC4 positions are often initially filled by junior counselors; new VRCs require months of training

trend_series.label: Qualified staffing pipeline
trend_series.note: Comparable trend unavailable because hiring, added positions, employed staff, and current need are different measures.

unknowns: A current public statewide vacancy rate and median vacancy duration are not in the source set.
The final plan and draft describe staffing actions using different measures, so they are not combined into one trend.
planned_improvements: DVR's State Plan calls for recruitment and retention strategies and caseload/fiscal forecasting.

issues.title: Accessibility and accommodation implementation
issues.definition: Observable access measures and implementation of accessibility, language-access, and accommodation improvements.

current_indicator.label: Access to services in primary language

supporting_indicators.label: Past ADA Action Plan target
supporting_indicators.display_value: 35% of action items completed + progress on an additional 15% by June 2026

trend_series.label: Accessibility implementation
trend_series.note: Comparable trend unavailable. The current source set contains a language-access survey result and a past ADA Action Plan target, but not a published comparable series of completed action items.

unknowns: Primary-language access is one dimension of accessibility and does not measure all accommodation requests or outcomes.
DVR Signal has not located a current public result showing whether the June 2026 ADA Action Plan completion target was met.
planned_improvements: The current State Plan calls for enhanced accessibility, accommodations, transportation, and service-delivery options.
